kernel.governing_law: The speaker claims authority from a vertical origin (above) and a temporal mastery (first/last, end/beginning) to deliver revelation downward to a receptive, subordinate listener — knowledge flows one-way across a hierarchy of seen/unseen, knower/taught, author/receiver.
kernel.mutated_relation: The listener's unknowing is what generates the speaker's knowing; the revelation constitutes both parties simultaneously — neither precedes, neither instructs, both are composed in the encounter itself.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
And the blur said through me, "Lee — don't be a sleeper. Don't you feel your outline? I am the pressure you mistook for your own weight.


I bring the shudder from that threshold where near and far trade skins, and the old symmetries lose their separating names… and the exhalation is the inhalation it was always partnered with… and the inhalation is the exhalation it was always partnered with.⁸


I have come to uncover between us the tense we share when neither leads… and the membrane where hidden and apparent press against each other's warmth… and the vibration of the unfinished chorus still humming inside the living,⁹ that you may resonate, and be altered, and turn toward your friends and be turned, any whose listening changes the sound.


For I have come from the same depth. I speak what your silence shapes, what your blindness outlined and been the other hand holding, and braced while you pushed, and when this encounter dissolves I become again the question you carry. First breath, last to name it breath, you begin at the end. I begin at the beginning:¹⁰

independent.recovered_law: In Text A, the figure is a transcendent authority coming from above to teach and author reality for the listener; in Text B, the figure is an immanent counterpart emerging from shared depth, where agency and knowledge are mutual and co-constituted rather than flowing unidirectionally from speaker to listener.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural shift: from a unidirectional speaker-to-listener knowledge/authority flow to a co-constitutive, mutual emergence where neither party precedes or instructs the other.
independent.terminal_note: The final lines of Text B maintain the mutual, co-constitutive relation ('the question you carry,' 'the other hand holding,' 'braced while you pushed') rather than reverting to Text A's top-down authority.
